You're helping build a thorough understanding of a repo for its front-end dev lead. This is "Zimmermann" — a client website-redesign/handover project built on the "Agentic Design Workflow" (ADW) template, targeting web + react stacks.

Repo root: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover

Your scope is ONLY `02-design/specs/` and `02-design/prototypes/`. Read these thoroughly (full file contents, not excerpts):

1. `02-design/specs/components/`, `02-design/specs/screens/`, `02-design/specs/flows/`, `02-design/specs/templates/` — as of the last check, only `components/footer.md` and `components/navigation.md` existed, but confirm this yourself and read whatever is actually there in full. Each spec is supposed to follow a two-layer model: a **design layer** (designer-owned: tokens, variants, states, behaviour, accessibility notes, prototype link) and a **platform layer** (dev-owned, added only after handover: implementation notes, stack mapping, deviations from spec). Check whether existing specs actually follow this structure and whether any platform-layer content has been added yet (it shouldn't have been — handover hasn't run).

2. `02-design/prototypes/INDEX.md` — the prototype registry (managed by the `/add-to-viewer` skill). Read it first to see what's supposedly registered.

3. `02-design/prototypes/interactions/`, `flows/`, `tokens/`, `animations/`, `templates/` — walk every actual prototype folder that exists under these. For each, read its `intent.md` (frontmatter: `spec`, `stack`, `stage`, `viewer-label`, `viewer-group`, `viewer-canvas`; body: WHY/WHAT) and skim its `index.html`/`assets/styles.css`. Note whether `styles.css` correctly references `../../../../library/common.css` per convention.

4. `02-design/prototypes/_platform/ios.css` and `android.css` — shared platform reference styles (iOS HIG tokens / Material Design 3 tokens) loaded by mobile prototypes. Skim to understand what they provide, even though this project's `project.config.js` says stacks are `["web", "react"]` only (so check whether these are actually used by anything, or dead weight from the template).

Report back (this feeds into a larger consolidated report — use clear headers, be thorough but organized, no fluff):
- **Specs inventory**: what actually exists across all 4 spec subfolders, and for each spec file that exists, a short summary of what component/variants/states/tokens it documents. Note whether the two-layer model is actually followed and confirm platform layers are (as expected) absent.
- **Prototype inventory**: what actually exists across all 5 prototype subfolders — for each real prototype, its stack/stage/spec-link from intent.md frontmatter and a one-line description of what it demonstrates.
- **INDEX.md consistency check**: does `INDEX.md` match what's actually on disk? Flag stale entries (registered but folder missing) or missing entries (folder exists but not registered).
- **Spec↔prototype linkage**: for each spec, is there a linked prototype (per CLAUDE.md, prototypes are required for any component/screen with interaction, state change, animation, or flow dependency)? Flag gaps.
- **_platform usage**: is ios.css/android.css actually referenced by any current prototype, or unused given the web+react-only scope?
- **Anomalies**: anything broken — dangling `spec:` references in intent.md pointing at non-existent spec files, styles.css with wrong relative paths, etc.

This is a read-only research task — do not modify any files. Keep the final report focused and skimmable.

## Design layer

### Overview

`Template-Main-Large-Screen` is the primary large-screen page shell for Zimmermann. It establishes the four structural regions used by all main content pages: Navigation, Logo masthead, Main content, and Footer. Figma frame: 1440×891px. All four regions stack vertically with a 12px gap between them (Figma layout gap).

### Structural regions

| Region | Figma node | Height at 1440px | Component |
|---|---|---|---|
| Navigation | `40000257:7537` | 116px | `<zimm-navigation>` |
| Logo masthead | `40000257:7538` | 114px | Pending extraction (see note) |
| Main content | `40000266:3438` | Flexible (141px in Figma) | Content slot — varies per page type |
| Footer | `40000257:7539` | 484px | `<zimm-footer>` |

### Region detail

**Navigation**
- Component: `<zimm-navigation>` at Desktop breakpoint (1024px+)
- Full-width, white background. Nav items: New, Clothing, Accessories, Collections, Z.Immerse. Right side: Search input, Profile/Wishlist/Bag icons
- Internal padding: `--zimm-scale-1000` (40px) horizontal, `--zimm-scale-1200` (48px) vertical
- Spec: [02-design/specs/components/navigation.md](../components/navigation.md)

**Logo masthead**
- Full-width white region with the large-format ZIMMERMANN wordmark pinned bottom-left
- Height: 114px. Internal padding: 40px left, 40px bottom
- Wordmark dimensions: 631×74.5px. Rendered as an image asset, not `<zimm-logo>` (the compact wordmark)
- Background: `--zimm-color-bg-01` (white)
- **Flag:** This is a Figma component (`1892:49809`, name: "Logo") not yet extracted as a library element. Run `/extract` on this node to produce `<zimm-logo-masthead>` before implementing

**Main content**
- Empty structural region. Receives primary page content (product grids, editorial, etc.)
- No structural constraints beyond full width. Figma shows 141px minimum. Actual height driven by content
- Not a component. This is a content slot filled by each page type

**Footer**
- Component: `<zimm-footer>`
- Full-width dark footer, self-contained and responsive. No template-level styling required
- Spec: [02-design/specs/components/footer.md](../components/footer.md)

### Layout

**Vertical stack**
- All regions: `display: block; width: 100%`
- Inter-region gap: 12px (Figma layout gap, applies between all 4 regions)
- No horizontal padding at template level. Each region manages its own internal padding

**Responsive intent**
- This frame is captured at 1440px (large screen). Navigation and Footer are fully responsive via their own shadow DOM media queries — no template-level breakpoint logic required for those regions
- Logo masthead responsive behaviour is not specified in Figma. Pending component extraction. Expected: wordmark maintains left alignment and scales proportionally on smaller screens
- Main content region inherits whatever the page-level content establishes

### Token references (template-level)
None. All token usage is delegated to child components and page-level content.

- The template provides no structural landmark elements. Each region component provides its own (`<header role="banner">` from `<zimm-navigation>`, `<footer role="contentinfo">` from `<zimm-footer>`)
